about.title:
Engineering the core.
Crafting the surface.
about.p1: I'm a software engineer from Egypt and a 2026 graduate of EELU. I like owning a problem end to end — the interface people touch and the system that makes it work.
about.p2: Right now I'm building Dar Al-Ruya, a Laravel platform serving 12K–16K active users, and I've just shipped the frontend of Elkhalily, a fully RTL e-commerce store. My main languages are TypeScript, Java, C# (.NET) and Python, and on the web I work mostly with Next.js, Angular and Laravel.
about.p3: I learn fast, write things down, and care a lot about details that only show up when they're missing: spacing, focus states, loading time, Arabic typography.
